The park's origins date back to 2004, when it was re-planned in preparation for the grand celebration of the 1000th anniversary of Thang Long, the glorious capital of Vietnam.

Visitors can stroll along the park's stone-paved paths, surrounded by lush green lawns, and take in the breathtaking views of Hoan Kiem Lake. The park is especially attractive in the early morning, when the sun rises over the lake, casting a golden glow over the entire area, and on weekends, when the park comes alive with music and laughter.
